issues.title: QA — Controls (all games): gamepad support + a better touch pad, declared per game
issues.body: Controls for **every game**. Jon's direction: use a state-of-the-art controller and/or combine it with the d-pad; Raccoon Heist's controls are better than the rest, and we can beat them; layouts can be somewhat bespoke per game.

issues.title: QA — MOMENTUM RUNNER: longer zones, more to do
issues.body: Gameplay pass for **MOMENTUM RUNNER** (`/momentum`). Jon's direction: a lot more detail in the gameplay. Today the autopilot finishes all three zones in about **12 seconds** (721 ticks), so there is barely a game.

issues.title: QA — MOMENTUM RUNNER: high-end futuristic look
issues.body: Polish pass for **MOMENTUM RUNNER** (`/momentum`). Jon's direction: **fancy, high-end, futuristic — way up-level the graphics, lots of detail.** This is an original game (Sonic-like, not a port), so that direction replaces ART.md rule 1 ("looks like the original"); rules 2–6 still apply. Everything

issues.title: QA — OUT RUN: polish pass
issues.body: Polish pass for **OUT RUN** (shipped via #282, live at /out-run). Chasing `docs/ART.md` and the original cabinet. All original code/audio — keep it that way (three ORIGINAL radio tunes; never the cabinet's tracks).

issues.title: QA — SMASH TV: polish pass
